analyze.title: Analyze
analyze.heading: Where should the analysis run?
analyze.lead: Painfold sends the cleaned feedback to an AI, which finds what your customers are trying to do, what gets in their way and what they wish for. You choose the AI, and you see exactly what is sent before anything goes.

modelNote.claude-sonnet-5-5: More careful, about 20 times the price

key.label: API key
key.get: Get an API key from Anthropic

problem.unreachable: Anthropic could not be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
problem.browserBlocked: Your Anthropic organisation does not allow calls from browsers. An admin can allow them in the Anthropic Console.
problem.invalidKey: Anthropic did not accept this key. Check it and try again.
problem.noAccess: This key has no access to {model}.
problem.rateLimited: Too many requests right now. Wait a minute and try again.
problem.overloaded: Anthropic is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
problem.modelMissing: {model} is not available for this key.
problem.other: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

ollama.permissionNote: Chrome and Edge ask once whether this site may reach programs on your computer. Choose Allow.
ollama.found: Ollama is running and answers this site.
ollama.notFound: Painfold cannot reach Ollama. It may not be running, it may not allow this site yet, or the browser’s permission was refused.
ollama.noModels: Ollama is running but has no models yet. Download one with the command in step 1.
ollama.safari: Safari does not let websites reach programs on this computer, so Ollama cannot be used here. Use Chrome, Edge or Firefox.

run.heading: Analyzing {n} cleaned texts with {model}
run.stopping: Stopping: the requests already sent are finishing, nothing new is sent.
run.cancelled: Stopped: {done} of {total} texts are analysed. Nothing more was sent.
run.paused: Paused at {done} of {total}. Resume sends only the texts not analysed yet.
run.droppedQuotes: 1 quote did not match its text word for word and was left out. | {n} quotes did not match their text word for word and were left out.
run.notAnalysed: 1 text could not be analysed. | {n} texts could not be analysed.
run.needKey: Enter your API key above first.
run.needOllama: Choose a model in Ollama above first.
run.needNames: Confirm the line about names first.
run.leak: Nothing can be sent while something you removed would be in it.
